question: Which bowler has the lowest bowling average per wicket taken?
sql:
-- Bowler 53 (AC Gilchrist) has the lowest bowling average of 0.0
-- He bowled 2 deliveries, conceded 0 runs, and took 2 wickets
-- Let's get the final answer with his name
WITH bowler_runs AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bowler
),
bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, COUNT(*) as wickets
    FROM wicket_taken w
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON w.match_id = b.match_id AND w.over_id = b.over_id AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id
    GROUP BY bowler
)
SELECT p.player_name, br.total_runs, bw.wickets, 
       ROUND(br.total_runs * 1.0 / bw.wickets, 2) as bowling_avg
FROM bowler_runs br
JOIN bowler_wickets bw ON br.bowler = bw.bowler
JOIN player p ON br.bowler = p.player_id
WHERE bw.wickets > 0
ORDER BY bowling_avg ASC
LIMIT 1
